p.seg: the burghers("roturiers/non-aristocratic local inhabitants?) of the Zhou territory were about to transfer the administration (of the land) to (the state of Western) Guo. (This is an extraordinarily important entry for an understanding of the inner workings of the Zhou ("Vatican") territory and the political role of the local "roturiers" in the territory. This passage needs a great deal of attention. It does not seem natural to take 周人to refer to members of 周室 “the House of Zhou". 待考！！！！！）

The former ruler (choosing between his own son and myself) considered me the more talented, (it is important to realise that the Duke is not here suggesting (very impolitely indeed!) that the revered former ruler considered his own son (completely) untalented: he just found the Duke MORE the more talented of the candidates. Compare Mandarin: 她漂亮 “she is the prettier one", and NOT "she is pretty". )
You, sir, should never reject/disregard the contribution of the former ruler (i..e the contribution he made in preferring me to his own son)."
And he went on to command (his son) Prince Feng to leave the capital and settle in Zheng.
